deadline.value: February 1, 2027 for Fall admission and priority Graduate Assistantship consideration (Bulletin also notes rolling review when requested by a SAM faculty advisor).
deadline.quote: Submit all materials by Feb. 1 for consideration for Fall admission.

also.quote: Priority consideration for graduate assistantships: Feb. 1

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional in SAM Ph.D. admissions.
gre_general.quote: Transcripts of previous undergraduate and graduate studies, optional GRE scores, a statement of research interests and letters of recommendation will be used in evaluating candidates for admission.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Materials Science (Subject Tests exist only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact a participating SAM faculty member first, be sponsored by a faculty advisor willing to accept them, and applications are reviewed only upon written request of a SAM faculty advisor.
supervisor.quote: First, contact a faculty member you’d like to work with. Your application must be sponsored by a participating faculty member who is willing to take you into his or her research program.

also.quote: Applications will only be considered upon the specific written request of a SAM faculty advisor.

funding.value: Priority consideration for graduate assistantships (stipend plus tuition waiver) is February 1; assistantships are awarded via participating departments and research grants.
funding.quote: Priority consideration for graduate assistantships: Feb. 1

also.quote: Graduate assistant positions provide a stipend as well as a tuition waiver.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree in physics, chemistry, biochemistry, biology, geology, engineering, mathematics, or another relevant science is required for entry (minimum 60 graduate credits beyond bachelor's with up to 15 transfer credits).
entry_route.quote: Students may enter the program with diverse backgrounds, but a Master's degree in a relevant field is required.

notes: Interdisciplinary 60-credit-hour Ph.D. in Science of Advanced Materials combining physics, chemistry, engineering, and materials characterization/modeling.
name: Ph.D. in Science of Advanced Materials
